title: Publication Metadata Response
description: Structured output of the publication-metadata-generation LLM call, before persist_metadata_variants(). Chapter start times and the deterministic attribution block are computed server-side, never trusted from this response — chapter_labels here supplies TEXT ONLY (see docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#chapters). `titles` must contain at least 5 genuinely different options.

intro_chapter_label.description: Label for the always-present 0:00 introduction chapter (covering the hook+intro narration). Defaults to "Introduction" if omitted.

chapter_labels.description: One entry per script section_id. Text only — start times are always computed server-side from the voiceover's own timing package, never from this field.

disclaimers_text.description: Deterministically assembled from the channel's publication_policy.disclaimers by the caller before this is persisted — never authored by the LLM.
